For anyone coming from the un-updated docs:
`yarn add -D @tauri-apps/api `
Still, I cannot able to import. I am getting this error "TypeError: Module name, '@tauri-apps/api' does not resolve to a valid URL." and @tauri-apps/api is in dev-dep

Adding the _api_ as a _dev_ dependency doesn't make much sense to me tbh. The cli is a dev dependency, but not the api. (that said, it shouldn't reallyyy make a difference, most tools handle dev and normal deps the same).

Can you show how you added the dependency to package.json and how you're trying to import it in js/ts?

for me installing @tauri-apps/api as a dependecy worked!
pnpm add @tauri-apps/api
Changing to `import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/core'` worked for me.

> Changing to `import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/core'` worked for me.

Same here.

"vite": "^5.4.10",
"@tauri-apps/api": "^2.0.3",

tauri = { version = "2.0.6", features = [] }

this really helped me:
